sections: • Auth: Authorization: Bearer <token> header on every call except /auth/login and /auth/forgot-password
• All List endpoints support pagination (page, pageSize) and return { page, pageSize, totalRecords, data }
• Dates are ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD); timestamps are ISO-8601 with time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)
• Delete on master tables is a soft-delete (isActive=false); referenced records cannot be deleted, only deactivated
raw_preview: Derived from the CAIMS UI (CAIMS_ui_updated__5_.html) and the Database Table Structure data dictionary. All endpoints are prefixed with /api/v1 and require a Bearer token (see Auth sheet) unless noted.
• Auth: Authorization: Bearer <token> header on every call except /auth/login and /auth/forgot-password
• All List endpoints support pagination (page, pageSize) and return { page, pageSize, totalRecords, data }
• Dates are ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD); timestamps are ISO-8601 with time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)
• Standard HTTP status codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict, 423 Locked, 429 Too Many Requests, 500 Internal Server Error
